(87)e ma hoḥchos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje 'chang*/mngon rdzogs dgongs brgyud ston pa bcu gnyis dang*/dga' rdor la sogs brda brgyud rig 'ji

tei:div.tei:p: (87)e ma hoḥ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje 'chang*/ mngon rdzogs dgongs brgyud ston pa bcu gnyis dang*/ dga' rdor la sogs brda brgyud rig 'jin lnga/ ting 'jin bzang po lhang ma lhun rgyal sogs/ snyan brgyud rig 'jin tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ khyad par rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams pa/ smon lam 'di la mgon pos dpang mjod cig bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ 'od gsal snying po'i yang zhun bcu bdun rgyud/ mjod chen bdun dang yang tig rnam pa gsum/ zab dang rgya che'i gsang ba'i gnas rnams kun/ mi brjed gzungs kyis tshig don sems la shar/ spobs pa rgya mtshos 'gro la chos (88)sgo 'byed/ chos nyid dgongs bar mtshams med par shog bi ma mi tra dri med 'od zer gyis/ mngon sum ye shes sku yi rjes bzung nas/ don brgyud rtogs pa'i dgongs pa bdag la 'phos/ kun mkhyen bla ma khyed bzhin 'gyur bar shog zhing 'dir bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib rdzogs pa dang*/ bstan pa'i btsas gsum mjes ldan bkod par 'bebs/ zhing khams de ru bdag gis thos bsam zhing*/ bsgom pas gsang chen bstan pa 'jin pa dang*/ 'gro la chos kyi sgo 'phar 'byed gyur cig de nas byang phyogs yangs pa skyob pa'i zhing*/ sangs rgyas ut+pal me tog mjes pa'i drung*/ 'khor gyi thog mar bdag nyid skye bar shog bde bar gshegs pa tshul bzhin brten pa dang*/ smin grol zab mo'i bdud rtsi rab tu myong*/ sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byed par shog de nas bstan pa'i btsas gsum nub phyogs 'phar/ gtsug phud dbyangs zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten 'bebs/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis bzung nas lo/ 'bum phrag bdun du bstan pa gnas pa la/ bdag nyid dang po (89)sras kyi thu bo dang*/ bar du rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab nyid du gyur/ tha ma gdul bya'i lhag ma ma lus pa/ bdag nyid gcig pus thams cad smin grol la/ bkod nas thar pa dam pa'i gling bgrod shog

skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ gzungs dang blo gros spobs pa dbang 'byor nas/ gsang ba'i gsang ba 'od gsal bcu bdun rgyud/ rang shar rang grol rgyud dang yi ge med/ rgyud kyi snying po rje 'bangs 'jom pa lta'i/ ma nor gzungs kyis rgyud la 'jin pa dang*/ spobs pas 'gro la chos char 'bebs par shog nor bu phra bkod thugs kyi me long dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long rgyud/ rab tu gsang ba rgyud kyi dwangs ma gsum/ ma nor gzungs kyis rgyud la 'jin pa dang*/ spobs pas 'gro la chos char 'bebs par shog rdzogs pa'i rang byung rgyud kyi sdom gcig pu/ ngo sprod spras pas snang ba gting nas rjogs/ ye shes g.yul bzlog nyi zla kha sbyor rgyud/ ma tshang kha skong rin chen spungs pa dang*/ sku gdung 'bar ba rgyud kyi yan lag gnyis/ ma nor gzungs (90)kyis rgyud la 'jin pa dang*/ spobs pas 'gro la chos char 'bebs par shog rnal 'byor grol ba sgron me 'bar ba'i rgyud/ snying dang 'dra ba klong drug rgyud dang ni/ rang gzhung gsang ba thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud/ nag mo khros ma 'gal byed brlag pa'i rgyud/ ma nor gzungs kyis rgyud la 'jin pa dang*/ spobs pas 'gro la chos char 'bebs par shog rgyus par ston pa gsang ba mjod chen bdun/ zab mo man ngag snying thig ma bu bzhi'i/ gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa dang*/ tshe rabs 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ mi 'bral dam chos mkha' 'gros rjes gnang dang*/ kun mkhyen bla mas mngon sum 'dom par shog rgyu dang man ngag zab me rab 'byed pa'i/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i blo gros snang ba thob/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i shes rab mig rnyed nas/ tshul gsum tshang ba'i rig pa'i dbang 'byor nas/ dri med 'od zer khyed kyi lta dgongs dang*/ ting 'jin spyod pa ji bzhin bdag gyur nas/ 'gro ba'i phan bde bdag gis 'grub par shog

ces pa 'di ni kun mkhyen/ (91) bla ma gsol ba snying nas 'debs gcig su bas/ rang gi yun ring du smon lam 'di nyid sems la bcings nas smon pa 'di dang skal ba mnyam pa'i snyigs ma'i skye bo re zung gis bton na phan nam snyam pa'i sgo nas bris pa'o/ bkra shis shog ༈ bdag ni deng nas skye dang tshe rabs su/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang bshes gnyen dam par 'phrad/ ci gsung bka' sgrub zab mo'i lta ba rtogs/ rin chen byang chub sems kyi rang dbang 'byor/ rgyal sras rgyal ba'i rnam thar yongs zlum pa'i/ rdzogs smin sbyang ba rgya mtsho'i spyod pa kun/ bdag nyid gcig pus thams cad spyod gyur cig ༈ na mo kun mkhyen bla ma sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i gar/ lnga brgya'i 'gro ba'i mgon gcig bstan pa'i dpal/ gsang chen bstan pa'i bdag po bla ma rje/ bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang lam nas/ tshe gcig chos zad gdod ma'i dbyings su gshegs/ gdod ma'i mgon dang zhal mi gnyis pa yi/ bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/(92)paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen 'gro ba'i mgon/ mngon snang theg mchog gsal ba'i sgron me che/ thugs rje rlabs chen gzhan dang mtshungs med pa'i/ bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ byin brgyud bu la rtsol gcig rin po che/ rtsol med gnas lugs blta bas rang ngo mthong*/ 'jin med bsgom pa gom pa'i dbyings su chod/ zhen med spyod pa'i gegs 'phrang rang sar zhing*/ gdod ma'i sa la grub mtha' snyogs par shog ༈ gsang bdag dpa' bo'i dngos snang he ru ka/ phur pa mchog grub dgongs pa'i gdeng tshad brnyes/ pad+ma'i rjes bzung zab mo gter gyi bdag mthu stobs gling pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/// /
